remarks: Welcome to your New Turn-Key Home or Investment! This unit has been meticulously updated and maintained. From pristine hardwood floors throughout, to an updated bathroom and kitchen, this unit is move-in ready OR ready to rent! Plenty of storage in the unit as the owner has designed in-unit storage that blends in with the existing closets and shelves. Additional storage is in the basement. Assigned parking and plenty of visitor parking make life easier, especially after work! This unit is conveniently located in the heart of Norwalk, close to Norwalk Hospital, minutes to The Sono Collection Mall, Train Station, Stew Leonard's, Wegmans, Target and short drive to Calf Pasture Beach. I-95 and Rte 7 access is also a true convenience for commuters. This unit is priced to sell, and whether you're an investor or a homebuyer, this is definitely a deal worth looking at!
